licenses.component: BG2 HD maps and UI assets
licenses.source: project production runs and approved UI assets
licenses.provenance: derived HD assets are listed file-by-file in content.json; no original game executable or raw game archive is distributed

requires: a legitimate copy of the supported game
distribution of the archive intact with its notices, credits and checksums
clear provenance for each release asset
a public contact or issue channel before the first online release
forbids: commercial sale, paid access or commercial bundling
redistribution of game executables, Steam files, EEex or InfinityLoader
repackaging the mod or its HD assets in another mod without prior agreement
claiming official affiliation with Beamdog, Wizards of the Coast or Steam
distribution_policy.notice: Unofficial community modification. Baldur's Gate and related marks remain the property of their respective owners. This policy is a community-distribution policy, not a warranty of third-party rights.
distribution_policy.takedown_process: Before public release, publish a contact route and promptly review good-faith removal or attribution requests.

excluded_from_payload: all Steam configuration and account files

technical_overlay_decision.reason: WTLAKE and WTPOOL are SeedVR2 7B x2 resources; the agreed alpha scope is x4/7B zones only.
